integrity: The all-parameter statement is supported by a symbolic proof. The included exact-rational checker is a regression test and is not treated as an exhaustive proof. Originality is based on statement-level comparison with the inspected primary sources and targeted searches; residual terminology risk is recorded.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the four-state reversible path product, a corner target, and the rank-one oracle. It proves an exact active-space reduction but does not determine the optimal search parameter, optimal time, or quantum speedup. Equivalent abstract formulations may exist under tensor-product Krylov or association-scheme terminology.
title: Exact corner spectral measure and quadratic Grover reduction on weighted \(P_4\) Cartesian powers
